title: 第3章 太古吞神血脉第4章 一拳杀一人
slug: 噬神塔第1929章小金的战力
lines: 噬神塔中。
秦易正在研究太古吞神血脉，越深入了解，越是大骇。
可以吞噬世间任何血脉，而且吞噬的越多，自身血脉越强。
强到极致，可吞星空大地，诸天万道。
这也太逆天了吧？
塔外。
漆黑的夜空下，乱葬岗显得更加阴森恐怖。
寒风瑟瑟，大地都被雪花覆盖。
“浩少爷，您放心，那秦欣儿已经死的透透的了。”
远处，有一行人走来。
为首之人，赫然是将秦欣儿重创的秦浩，他是秦家大长老之子，仗着自己父亲位高权重，飞扬跋扈，经常欺负弱小。
秦浩冷哼一声。
这种鬼地方，阴森恐怖，让人后背发凉。
大晚上的谁愿意来啊。
他倒不是担心秦欣儿没死，而是隔壁李家已经出钱，将秦欣儿的尸体买走，要给他们年幼夭折的那个少爷配阴魂。
沙沙沙！
大雪被踩出了一个又一个的脚印，不一会儿下人们就带着秦浩，来到了抛尸之地。
嗯？
秦浩一眼就看到了前方的墓碑，上边赫然写着秦欣儿的名字。
他瞬间明白，一定是秦易那个残废，偷偷的跑来乱葬岗，埋葬的秦欣儿。
“浩少爷，怎么回事？”有下人问道。
其他下人道：“还能怎么回事，肯定是秦易干的。”
随即。
众人环视四周，想要寻找秦易的踪迹。
秦浩眼眸中闪过了一丝冰冷杀意。
身为曾经青云城最耀眼的天才，秦易光芒万丈，而他秦浩连狗腿子的资格都不够。
他永远无法忘记，秦易对他的那种鄙夷眼神。
咔嚓！
秦浩拳头紧握，动了杀意。
反正秦易的天脉已经被秦策堂哥挖走，变成一个废人，将他杀了丢在乱葬岗，恐怕也无人知晓。
“他跟他妹妹感情很好，一定会为秦欣儿守墓，你们四处找找他的踪迹。”秦浩吩咐道，同时也让两个人留下来，开始挖掘秦欣儿的坟墓。
咔嚓！
他一脚踹碎了秦欣儿的墓碑，说道：“真是晦气，要不是李家给的太多，老子才不会来这种鬼地方。”
沙沙沙！
秦浩的仆人们，朝着四面八方走去，寻找秦易踪迹。
不一会儿。
他们就发现了已经失去生机的那头金钱豹。
content_en:
In the God-Eating Tower.
Qin Yi is studying the ancient bloodline of swallowing gods. The more he understands, the more horrified he becomes.
It can swallow any bloodline in the world, and the more it swallows, the stronger its own bloodline becomes.
It is so powerful that it can swallow the stars, the sky, the earth, and all the heavens and myriad ways.
Isn’t this too outrageous?
Outside the tower.
Under the dark night sky, the mass graves looked even more eerie.
The wind was freezing and the ground was covered with snowflakes.
"Master Hao, don't worry, Qin Xin'er is completely dead."
In the distance, a group of people came.
The leader was Qin Hao, the man who severely injured Qin Xin'er. He was the son of the eldest elder of the Qin family. Relying on his father's high position and power, he was domineering and often bullied the weak.
"Hmph."
Qin Hao snorted coldly.
This kind of ghost place is so eerie and terrifying that it makes people feel chills down their backs.
Who wants to come late at night?
It was not that he was worried that Qin Xin'er was not dead, but that the Li family next door had paid to buy Qin Xin'er's body in order to give it to their young master who died young.
Swish, swish, swish!
The heavy snow was trampled one footprint after another, and soon people took Qin Hao to the place where the body was dumped.
Um?
Qin Hao saw the tombstone in front of him at a glance, with Qin Xin'er's name clearly written on it.
He instantly understood that it must be the crippled Qin Yi who secretly came to the mass grave to bury Qin Xin'er.
"Master Hao, what's going on?" a servant asked.
Other servants said: "What else could happen? It must be Qin Yi."
Immediately.
Everyone looked around, trying to find traces of Qin Yi.
A hint of cold murderous intent flashed in Qin Hao's eyes.
As the most dazzling genius in Qingyun City, Qin Yi was brilliant, but he, Qin Hao, was not even qualified to be a loser.
He could never forget Qin Yi's disdainful look towards him.
Click!
Qin Hao clenched his fists with murderous intent.
Anyway, Qin Yi's heavenly veins had been poached by Qin Ce's cousin, and he was turned into a useless person. If he was killed and thrown into a mass grave, no one would know about it.
"He has a very good relationship with his sister and will definitely guard Qin Xin'er's grave. You should look for traces of him everywhere." Qin Hao ordered, and at the same time asked two people to stay and start digging Qin Xin'er's grave.
Click!
He kicked Qin Xin'er's tombstone into pieces and said, "It's really unlucky. If the Li family hadn't given her too much, I wouldn't have come to this ghost place."
Swish, swish, swish!
Qin Hao's servants walked in all directions, looking for traces of Qin Yi.
Soon.
They discovered the leopard that had lost its vitality.
